_comment: ilk-skills meta-project marker. Drop this file at the root of a 'polyrepo' parent directory that itself is not a git repo but contains several sibling git repos that ship together as one logical product. ilk-loop will treat this directory as the project root, derive project_key from its absolute path, and store plans/runtime/logs under ~/.ilk-data/projects/<key>/. Each sub-plan declares repo: <member-name> to route its commits/CI/ship into the right member repo. See ilk-loop/docs/meta-projects.md for the full convention.
name: <short project name; e.g. myproj>
